title: MC Manifest — per-path ownership declaration
description: Authored under SP-20260522-001. Lives at `_mc/MANIFEST.json` in installed products and declares per-path ownership for every framework-influenced path. Replaces the implicit ownership scheme that the now-retired /warp:promote suite carried. Built by scripts/mc/manifest/build.js; consumed by /mc:update (refuses to overwrite project-owned files), /warp:rollback (snapshot scope), /scan:mc-manifest-coverage (diff on-disk vs manifest), /scan:framework-views-fresh (generated views match source), the regenerator (.claude/commands + .claude/agents rebuilt byte-identical from _mc/), and the three-layer settings.json compiler.

$schema.description: Schema id pinned to v1 so consumers can refuse a manifest they don't understand.

version.description: Integer schema version. Bumped on breaking changes; downstream consumers MUST check before reading.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the manifest was emitted. Compared against on-disk file mtimes by /scan:mc-manifest-honesty.

generatedBy.description: Pointer to the generator that wrote this file (e.g. 'scripts/mc/manifest/build.js@<sha>').

mcVersion.description: Installed MC version at generation time (mirrors version.json#version).

schemaVersion.description: Optional secondary version field for downstream migration tooling. Mirrors `version`; allows future split where the manifest spec versions independently of MC releases.

migrations.description: Ordered list of migration ids that have been applied to this install's manifest. Populated by scripts/mc/manifest/migrate.js as schema versions evolve.

paths.description: Map of project-relative path → ownership declaration. Every framework-influenced path that exists on disk after /mc:setup MUST be enumerated; missing entries are caught by /scan:mc-manifest-coverage.

ownerClass.description: Ownership class. framework=managed copy, byte-identical to source; generated=compiled deterministically from layered inputs; project=seeded once then user-owned, never auto-overwritten on update; runtime=written by hooks/sessions, never touched on update.

fileClass.description: Semantic class. fillable=template seeded for user to fill (CORE_BRIEF.md, etc); reference=framework reference doc (don't edit); guide=human-facing walkthrough; code=executable; config=settings/manifest; data=jsonl/json runtime data.

managed.description: True if /mc:update will overwrite this path to match the framework source. Required-by-convention for owner=framework. Always false for owner=project and owner=runtime.

source.description: For owner=framework: project-relative pointer to the _mc/ source-of-truth that this path mirrors (e.g. '_mc/commands/fix/fast.md'). Update reads source and writes this entry's path byte-identically.

seeded_from.description: For owner=project: project-relative ADVISORY provenance pointer to the resolvable seed source for this path. As of 0.16.0 the generator emits the real on-disk path (e.g. `_requirements/<x>` or the decision-policy file), not the previously-dangling `<source-prefix>/templates/...` (prefix-drift). Advisory-only — nothing dereferences it at install. The `_mc/templates/`/`_mc/BASELINE/` end-state and the `seed_drift` /mc:update contract are DEFERRED until those source dirs are built (SP-20260522-001).

compiled_from.description: For owner=generated: ordered list of project-relative input paths the compiler reads to produce this entry. First entry is the framework-default layer; subsequent entries are project-override layers. Order matters; later entries win on conflicting keys.

compiler.description: For owner=generated: project-relative pointer to the compiler script (e.g. 'scripts/mc/settings/compile.js'). Lets gates verify the entry by re-running the compiler and diffing output.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file content at manifest generation time. For owner=framework: should match the source file's sha256. Drift between sha256 and on-disk content is detected by /scan:mc-manifest-honesty.

installedSha.description: SHA-256 at install time. Diverges from sha256 when the user modifies a project-owned file or when a framework file has drifted. Updated by /mc:setup + /mc:update only; never by runtime writes.

currentSha.description: Optional: SHA-256 of the file's current on-disk content. Populated by /mc:update --status. Useful for surfacing drift without re-walking the tree.

userModified.description: True if /mc:update has detected user modifications to a framework- or project-owned file (i.e., currentSha !== installedSha). Surfaces in update reports so the user knows their changes are at risk.

class.description: Optional semantic file class. Lets UI tools group fillable templates separately from reference docs.

introducedIn.description: MC version this path first appeared in (mirrors framework/paths.registry.json convention).

removedIn.description: MC version this path was removed. Non-null entries are tombstones for the un-installer.

kind.description: Filesystem entry kind. Mirrors framework/paths.registry.json. Lets gates validate that a file path doesn't get an entry expecting a directory.

_note.description: Free-text per-path note (rationale, gotchas, cross-references). Not interpreted; human-readable only.
